document.abstract: This practice defines the data stream used for synchronous transmission of HD-D5 compressed video and audio data over 360 Mb/s serial digital interface (SDI) for the 525/60 system as defined in ANSI/SMPTE 259M. — This practice does not define data stream structure applicable for transmission over the serial data transport interface (SDTI), SMPTE 305M.
